column2: Paano mag-setup ng Tailwind CSS sa React project?
column4: i-install: npm install -D tailwindcss, i-init: npx tailwindcss init, i-add ang directives sa CSS

column2: Paano gumawa ng responsive design gamit ang Tailwind?
column4: <div className='w-full md:w-1/2 lg:w-1/3'> — gamitin ang breakpoint prefixes

column2: Paano mag-enable ng dark mode sa Tailwind?
column4: <div className='bg-white dark:bg-black'> — i-add ang dark: prefix sa utilities

column2: Paano i-customize ang theme sa Tailwind?
column4: I-edit ang tailwind.config.js: theme: { extend: { colors: { primary: '#3b82f6' } } }

column2: Paano mag-apply ng responsive na mobile-first layout?
column4: Gamitin ang: <div className='grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4'>
